asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

said.said: I put "situation" in the blank. The sentence now reads "I can explain the situation."
I expected the word to go into the blank, and it did. I didn't know what the screen was for at first, so I just tapped a word to see.

It's a word magnet game. You tap a word and it fills the blank in the sentence, and the group can see it and change it. Tapping a word in the sentence takes it out again. The word I picked moved out of the list and into the sentence.

asked.prompt: Was anything too much? Leave it empty if nothing was.

said.said: Nothing was too much. The words are small, though, so I'd want my glasses.

asked.prompt: Was there a moment you almost left? Leave it empty if not.

said.said: No, I never thought of leaving.
